headline: **MLB Daily Recap: May 28, 2026**
article:
The Toronto Blue Jays secured a 1-2 series win over the Miami Marlins, with Kazuma Okamoto leading the offense. Eury Pérez pitched 4.0 strong innings for the Marlins, striking out 9 batters without allowing an earned run.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Jose Quintana, who was transferred to the 60-day injured list by the Colorado Rockies due to a left elbow sprain. The Boston Red Sox placed Garrett Whitlock on the 15-day injured list retroactive to May 25, 2026, due to left knee inflammation. The Toronto Blue Jays also made several roster moves, transferring Lazaro Estrada to the 60-day injured list and placing Lenyn Sosa on the 10-day injured list retroactive to May 27, 2026.

The Los Angeles Angels made a significant trade, acquiring LHP Juanmi Vasquez from the Toronto Blue Jays in exchange for RHP Connor Seabold. The Colorado Rockies traded LHP Carson Palmquist to the Washington Nationals for cash, while the Philadelphia Phillies traded RHP Andrew Baker to the Colorado Rockies for future considerations. The Cincinnati Reds traded RF Rece Hinds to the Miami Marlins for RHP Zach McCambley.

top_news.title: **Marlins Fall Short in Toronto**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins dropped a 1-2 decision to the Toronto Blue Jays, with Kazuma Okamoto leading the offense with a home run and 1 RBI. Eury Pérez pitched 4.0 strong innings, striking out 9 batters without allowing an earned run.

top_news.title: **Nationals Fall Short in Cleveland**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals dropped a 2-3 decision to the Cleveland Guardians in their latest matchup. CJ Abrams led the Nationals at the plate with 2 hits, while Gavin Williams earned the win for the Guardians with 7 strong innings.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Fall Short in Milwaukee**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals dropped a 1-2 decision to the Milwaukee Brewers, with Bryan Torres leading the Cardinals' offense with 1 hit and 1 RBI in 4 at-bats. Dustin May pitched 7 strong innings for the Brewers, striking out 9 and allowing just 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Mariners Cruise Past Athletics 9-1**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners dominated the Oakland Athletics, securing a 9-1 victory behind a strong performance from Logan Gilbert. Gilbert pitched 6.0 innings, striking out 6 batters and allowing 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Angels Soar Past Tigers 7-1**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Angels secured a convincing 7-1 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Zach Neto and Mike Trout leading the charge for the winning team. Jack Flaherty was instrumental in the Angels' win, while Donovan Walton and Wenceel Pérez had notable performances for the Tigers.

top_news.title: **Twins Fall Short in South Side Showdown**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins suffered a 6-2 loss to the Chicago White Sox, with Tristan Gray and Colson Montgomery leading the way for the White Sox offense.

top_news.title: **Rockies' Quintana Shifted to 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Colorado Rockies left-hander Jose Quintana has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a left elbow sprain.

top_news.title: **Tigers Acquire LHP Juanmi Vasquez in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers made a move on May 27, 2026, acquiring LHP Juanmi Vasquez from the Toronto Blue Jays in exchange for RHP Connor Seabold.
